title: DISSATISFIED WITH PRODUCT
text:
I was expecting one of the bag options that showed on this site. I mean any of them. I got this one? I'm confused, I don't see this bag option on this site at all. I think it's really cheap looking. Some of the bottle came in a plastic zip lock bag. I could go buy these products at the grocery store. Why bother subscribing at all to this site.
I'm very, very disappointed. Won't be reordering.
label: negative
